main_body: snow-covered roofed well with stone base
top_band: snow-covered roof slope (white/light blue-grey) from row 1 to row 8, and well stone rim/opening from row 16 to 23
evidence: The well shows a clear 8-row foreshortened snow roof top (rows 1-8) overhanging the wooden supports (row 9 beam/shadow, rows 10-22 posts), and the stone well basin below shows a clear elliptical opening (rows 17-22, 6 rows deep) surrounded by a rim (rows 16 and 23) above a 7-row brick front face (rows 23-29).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul roofed well reference, the candidate's stone base is a flat rectangular block with a repetitive grid of dark mortar lines and only 2-3 grey tones, lacking the rounded cylinder shading and individual stone highlights of the reference. The bucket is a flat 2-tone rectangle and the dark well interior is an unshaded black fill.
